seoTitle: Fix "Disabled Accounts Can't Be Contacted" on Instagram
metaDescription: Fix Instagram's "disabled accounts can't be contacted" DM error, which can appear even after the other account is reactivated.
intro: Seeing "disabled accounts can't be contacted" when trying to message someone on Instagram usually means the account was disabled or deactivated, but the error sometimes lingers even after the person reactivates. This guide covers several fixes, from restricting and unrestricting to reinstalling the app.

steps.heading: Restrict and unrestrict the account
steps.body: Open the conversation, tap the person's name, tap the three dots, and select Restrict. Then go to Settings, find Restricted Accounts, search for the account, and choose Unrestrict.

steps.heading: Block and unblock the account
steps.body: If restricting doesn't help, block the account and then unblock it, and try sending your message again.

steps.heading: Delete the chat and re-follow
steps.body: Delete the entire conversation, unfollow the account, follow them again, then open a new chat and try messaging.

steps.heading: Update or reinstall Instagram
steps.body: Make sure Instagram is updated to the latest version, or uninstall and reinstall the app to clear any hidden issues.

faq.question: Does this error always mean the account is deactivated?
faq.answer: Usually yes, but the message can sometimes persist even after the person has reactivated their account, which is where these fixes help.

faq.question: Can I message someone who has temporarily deactivated Instagram?
faq.answer: No, you won't be able to send DMs to an account until the person reactivates it by logging back in.

faq.question: Will blocking and unblocking someone affect my relationship with them on Instagram?
faq.answer: Blocking and quickly unblocking is a troubleshooting step and shouldn't meaningfully change your follow status once resolved, though you may need to re-follow.

faq.question: What if none of these steps fix the error?
faq.answer: Try updating Instagram to the latest version or uninstalling and reinstalling the app to clear any hidden issues.
